**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no take-or-pay or minimum purchase obligation on us (Corio):

- **Fees are for ordered services/usage only** — Exhibit B prices license fees, MarketSite.net access and annual maintenance for what is actually licensed/supported (§§ 4.1–4.2); revenue-sharing fees are a percentage of revenue actually invoiced to Corio Customers (p0157); implementation is time-and-materials with a stated cap (p0161).
- **No volume cap on our usage** — Software Users are expressly "Unlimited" (p0151), and § 2.1(iv) permits sublicensing an unlimited number of Customers.
- **The two "minimum"/"shortfall" hits are benign** — the 40-Authorized-User floor only conditions the revenue-share exemption for the initial 3,000 licenses (p0158), and § 4.4 audit language provides for payment of a shortfall or refund of an overpayment, i.e. a true-up rather than a penalty (our preferred position).
- **Exhibit D commitments are expressly non-binding**, including the "use commercially reasonable efforts to obtain orders from two (2) Customers" item, so there is no purchase quota.

Noted for completeness (outside this rule): the five-year initial term with annual maintenance and MarketSite.net access fees and no termination-for-convenience right (§§ 11.1–11.2) is an exit/term issue better handled under the term and termination rules.
